Card Q&A.a: Card text that uses "delete," such as "Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon," can't be used to delete your cards with  They can still be deleted by losing battles or being reduced to zero DP.
Card Q&A.q: What does "can't be deleted by your opponent's effects" on this card's [All Turns] effect refer to, exactly?

Effect: ＜Blocker＞ (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
[Both Turns] All of your Digimon with ＜Blocker＞ can't be deleted by effects.
